features.description: Most-imported state primitives. useToggle/useCounter cover the majority of toggle/counter needs; history/cloned/cycle/stepper/previous/lastChanged round out local state.
features.evidence: Shipped 8/8 modules under src/lib/state/ (useToggle, useCounter, usePrevious, useLastChanged, useCloned, useCycleList, useStepper, useOffsetPagination), each with index.svelte.ts + index.ts, README.md, a jsdom suite and an SSR probe. 91 new state tests; suite is 266/266 across 42 files. Barrel exports all 8 plus their option/return interfaces. Zero assertions and zero suppressions despite no-unsafe-type-assertion: (1) useToggle avoids pushing a boolean literal into the generic slot by giving valuesToggle() the two values as arguments and calling it with an explicit T; arity-vs-explicit-undefined is carried in the type via rest args `[] | [T]` instead of arguments.length. (2) useCloned cannot structuredClone a reactive proxy (DOMException, pinned by a probe), so the default clone runs over $state.snapshot; the snapshot type is named with ReturnType<typeof defaultClone<T>> because Svelte does not export Snapshot, which keeps value exactly T for plain data with no cast. (3) useCycleList reads list items with a non-null assertion justified by the wraparound bounds check. Documented divergences: usePrevious returns T | undefined before the first change; useCycleList returns T (and -1 index) for an empty list, matching VueUse. Gates green.

features.description: Scroll position/lock/infinite lists plus pointer position primitives. Passive listeners; SSR fallbacks.
features.evidence: Ships 5 utils: useScroll, useMouse, useMousePressed, useScrollLock, useElementHover. 189 new tests across 10 files (33+30+25+20+20 browser, 7+16+16+13+7 SSR); suite is now 547/547 across 64 files. All five expose getter- or writable-getter-backed state, so destructuring keeps reactivity and bind: works on the two writable ones (useScroll.x/y, useScrollLock.locked). All useEventListener calls are passive; the one deliberate exception is useScrollLock's iOS touchmove guard, which must be non-passive to preventDefault and is attached per lock rather than per component. Every timer/listener/observer is released on unmount; the unmount teardowns restore scroll-lock overflow and cancel a pending hover delay from plain variables, because a $state read in a teardown sees the pre-destroy value. Parity notes recorded per util: useScroll drops VueUse's no-op RTL multiplier (Math.abs(x * -1) === Math.abs(x)) and resolves a Document target to documentElement for both read and write; useScrollLock drops VueUse's module-scope WeakMap (unsafe under SSR request sharing) and restores an author's own inline overflow instead of clearing it; useElementHover narrows the target to Element and cancels its pending delay on unmount, which VueUse leaks; useMouse/useMousePressed replace every DOM assertion with a structural predicate. useInfiniteScroll and useMouseInElement are DEFERRED to feat-017, not cut - both are thin wrappers over the IntersectionObserver / ResizeObserver+MutationObserver that feat-017 ships first, with the Svelte-native recipe and the reason recorded in docs/recipes.md (Scroll & pointer). Two inline MutationObservers are marked ponytail for consolidation into feat-017's useMutationObserver (useScroll observe.mutation, useElementHover triggerOnRemoval).

Ids & controllable state
features.description: The only two items promoted out of the svelte-base sweep, both qualifying under scope.md §3. useId: ids must match between the server render and hydration, which is a genuine env-branching problem (3.2), and every util that needs an id depends on it (3.4). Implement on top of $props.id() where a component is available; the module counter + Math.random() form in svbase is NOT portable as written (module-scope mutable state, scope.md §2, plus non-stable across server/client). README documents $props.id() as the first choice for component-level ids. useControllableState: non-trivial reactive state (internal value overridden by an external prop, with a setter) that core lacks and that useToggle/useCounter/useStorage each re-invent; Svelte has no controlled/uncontrolled primitive. Kept as a building block (3.4).

note: IMPLEMENTATION STATUS ONLY, AND ONLY FOR THIS PACKAGE. Every function here is something @wynn-dev/svelte-use ships. Functions that belong to another package are NOT tracked here — they live in that package's own feature_list.json (feat-030 moved to packages/svelte-use-integrations/feature_list.json; the svelte-base primitive helpers were removed from this file outright). A hook that both packages need is listed in BOTH lists and implemented twice: the packages are independent, so the copy is deliberate and must never be deduplicated by importing across the boundary. Anything deliberately not ported (Vue-specific, already a Svelte primitive, or lower value than its own recipe) lives in recipeRef with the Svelte-native replacement; that file is also the source for the Astro migration docs.
